dataTeam.title: Data teams are drowning in dashboards nobody reads
dataTeam.mainText: You spend hours building complex dashboards, only for stakeholders to ask the same ad-hoc questions on Slack. The backlog grows, insights are delayed, and valuable data engineers are stuck doing repetitive reporting tasks instead of strategic work.
dataTeam.footerText: It's time for a fundamental shift in how organizations interact with their data.

comments.title: Don't just take our word for it

user1.comment: Lumen has completely changed how our executive team operates. We no longer wait until Monday for reports; we just ask Lumen on Friday afternoon and get answers instantly.

user2.comment: As a data engineer, I used to spend 60% of my week pulling ad-hoc CSVs. Now, stakeholders self-serve through Lumen, and I can focus on building our core infrastructure.

user3.comment: The automated anomaly detection caught a billing issue a week before our standard reporting would have noticed it. It practically paid for itself in one day.
